approach.title: Our approach to eCommerce growth
approach.desc1: At Persici, we do not believe in cookie-cutter playbooks. We build custom growth engines tailored to your unit economics, inventory dynamics, and brand positioning. From full-funnel paid media to custom engineering, every initiative is calculated for net-profitable scale.
approach.desc2: We embed directly within your team, maintaining continuous communication, daily data monitoring, and weekly sprint reviews to ensure seamless agility and explosive growth.

reviews.title: Words from those we scale

r1.name: Alexander Holm
r1.review: The strategic clarity and direct weekly communication from the Persici team is unmatched. In 4 months, our international revenue grew over 210% with profitable ROAS.

r2.name: Nadia Bensalem
r2.review: Persici transformed our Shopify store speed, UI, and checkout conversion rate. Combined with their Meta ad scaling, our monthly GMV doubled within one quarter.

r3.name: Henrik Møller
r3.review: Finding an agency that truly understands both high-level creative direction and deep performance data is rare. Persici has exceeded every benchmark we set.

r4.name: Karim Al-Hassan
r4.review: Their creative testing velocity is unreal. We went from burning cash on generic ads to having 8 evergreen winning ad angles in our first 6 weeks of partnership.

r5.name: Camilla Lind
r5.review: The team at Persici treated our budget like their own. Transparent reporting, proactive suggestions, and zero fluff. Could not recommend them more highly.

r6.name: Omar Farouq
r6.review: Within 30 days of onboarding, they rebuilt our tracking infrastructure, fixed server-side tracking, and restructured Google Ads. The ROI has been phenomenal.
